newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish rail says bus sale to Stagecoach complete.
newsitem.headline: Swedish rail says bus sale to Stagecoach complete.

text.p: The Swedish railways board (SJ) said on Tuesday the sale of its Swebus unit, the largest bus operator in the Nordic region, to the British company Stagecoach Holdings Plc was now in all essentials complete.
"There are only formalities remaining. The contract will be signed during the morning," SJ spokesman Bjorn Hallden told Reuters.
Hallden declined to comment on the settlement or on other aspects of the deal, referring to a news conference to be held by SJ and Swebus at 1100 GMT.
SJ's president Stig Larsson and Brian Souter, executive chairman of Stagecoach, will take part in the news conference, SJ said in a statement.
